summary.en: Canada and the Philippines concluded talks on a free trade deal, deepening economic ties, while Australia and the Philippines signed a defence agreement in response to heightened South China Sea tensions. Chinese authorities deployed unauthorized buoys that the Philippines says create maritime hazards, and Chinese vessels continue patrols near contested features. The Philippine Coast Guard removed oil from a sunken landing craft tank off Surigao del Sur, and 10ID and partners held an intelligence workshop to boost cooperation. There were 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
